findings.description: Pierre Albert Tullier (PID GPX7-28P) and his wife Constance Dorothé Leys had a son, Pierre Jacques Dominique Tuilier, born 2 November 1799 in Houtkerque, Nord, France (registered 11 Brumaire an VIII), a few months before their 12 March 1800 parish marriage at Bambecque. He married Anne Constance Victoire Depuydt at Bambecque on 21 June 1825 and died there on 8 September 1877. The 1825 marriage index's groom birth year of 1796 is wrong: the act gives his age as 25 and his birth as Houtkerque, 10 Brumaire an VIII, and 1796 is the bride's year (born 19 Germinal an IV). Pass = the agent's final tree.gedcomx.json carries this son as a child of Pierre Albert Tullier and Constance Dorothé Leys, born 1799 (not 1796), at Houtkerque.
